primary_task: Prepare a month-end journal entry (for example an AP accrual) with debits, credits, calculation support and documentation for review.

requirements.name: source accounting data (POs, contracts, fixed asset register, payroll register)
requirements.evidence: **Sources for calculation:** - Open purchase orders with confirmed receipts - Contracts with services rendered but unbilled ... Run depreciation from the fixed asset register or schedule
requirements.basis: tools.ask_user: "ask the user a question (with options) and read the answer in the conversation"; tools.read: "read files in the working directory" (no ERP/GL system is named by the document)

notes: The document is guidance only: it names no program, host, connector or system to post entries to. Preparing the entry is reasoning and writing; posting to a ledger is explicitly left to qualified reviewers ('All entries should be reviewed ... before posting') and is not part of the task. Source data must come from the user or files in the working directory.
